candidate.invalid_candidate: mask invalid and use native lane bytes for exported block;never select invalid

threshold.source: two finite transitions adjacent to actual native bucket;edge bins have only their finite side
threshold.transition: smallest finite FP32 score whose actual production locate(score)>=right_bucket_id;check transition and predecessor directly
threshold.ideal_t: exact real value of that FP32 transition represented in float64
threshold.true_equal_t: excluded from hinge sum but kept in fixed row denominator and machine error;report separately
threshold.prediction_equal_t: right-side included for machine error;hinge remains conservative surrogate
threshold.nonfinite_width_score_or_inconsistent_tr: fail whole run, do not silentlydrop rows
threshold.gamma: float64(actual FP32 width)/4;fixed before candidate fitting
threshold.interpretation: local native-bin adjacent-boundary error, not complete bucket-ID accuracy

support.primary: only proposals whose target has not been expanded in frozen native state;full32lanes descriptive
support.visited: all kind1 centers through current expansion;decode metadata across fullnativequery prefix
support.rows_Rq: all selected eligible state,lane,finite-boundary triples forquery q;includes true-threshold ties
support.query_error: sum(machine misclassifications over Rq)/nq;zero if nq=0
support.aggregate: mean over all fixed3072 training or1024validation queries

training.row_weight: 1/(3072*nq); same frozen support across methods,hinge excludestrue ties fromsum only
training.second_moment: per edge weighted mean (delta dot e)^2 + lambda*||e||^2; e=R*s/u-r;lambda=weighted mean||delta||^2/768;weights forstate are its finite-boundary row count/(3072*nq)
training.solver: enumerate all137 candidates,invalid masked; no LP/MIP used
training.numeric: float64 empirical objectives;record all objectives and min/runnerup gap;no claim exact rational global768D optimum
training.tie_break: minimum finite computed objective; exact numeric ties choose lowest candidate index so native0 first
training.no_effective_training_hinge_labels: native fallback forhinge only, report count
